clips.title: The story
paras: Magatha Grimtotem is the matriarch of the Grimtotem tribe and the Elder Crone of Thunder Bluff. A formidable shaman and political schemer, she resides on Elder Rise while continually challenging Cairne Bloodhoof's vision for the tauren nation.

Magatha rose to absolute authority over the Grimtotem through an arranged union followed by the sudden, fatal climbing accident of her mate. Operating from Elder Rise with her personal retinue and bodyguards, she stands as the undisputed political and spiritual leader of her reclusive tribe. Unlike Cairne Bloodhoof, Magatha preaches tauren dominance, viewing other mortal races as intruders upon Kalimdor who ought to be eradicated or swept aside.
